objectives.description: Identify and convert numbers between different number bases (binary, octal, decimal)
Find multiples, factors, LCM, and HCF of whole numbers using prime factorisation
Perform operations on fractions (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and convert between fractions and decimals
Calculate percentages, ratios, and proportions and apply them to real-life situations
Apply indices and standard form to express and compute with very large or very small numbers
Use logarithms (common logs) to simplify multiplication and division of numbers
Solve one-variable linear equations and represent solutions on a number line
Simplify and evaluate algebraic expressions involving one or more variables
Solve simultaneous linear equations using substitution and elimination methods
Factorise algebraic expressions and solve simple quadratic equations by factorisation
Represent real-life situations using algebraic equations and interpret results
Identify and classify types of angles and apply angle sum properties of triangles and quadrilaterals
Identify properties of 2D shapes (triangles, quadrilaterals, circles) and 3D figures (cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones, spheres)
Calculate perimeter, area, and volume of regular plane shapes and solid figures
Perform basic geometric constructions using ruler and compass (bisecting angles, constructing triangles)
Apply trigonometry to calculate angles of elevation, depression, and distances using scale drawings
Solve problems involving bearings and distances using cardinal points and scale drawing
Construct angles of 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°, 120° and copy given angles using geometric instruments
Collect, organise, and present data in frequency tables, bar charts, pie charts, and line graphs
Calculate and interpret measures of central tendency: mean, median, mode, and range for given data sets
Apply measures of central tendency to real-life problems and communicate findings clearly
Define probability as a measure of chance and calculate probability of simple events from experiments
Conduct simple probability experiments (coin toss, dice roll, ludo) and record outcomes
